description: A permanent partial disability (non-schedule) award from a loss of wage-earning capacity percentage: the weekly rate (the bounded two-thirds rate × the LWEC %, kept within the max and min), the number of weeks for that LWEC bracket (§15(3)(w): 225 to 525 weeks depending on the bracket), the award, and, with the weeks of temporary benefits already paid, the credit for weeks beyond 130. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

aww.description: Average weekly wage before the injury, in dollars (gross).

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.

prior_temporary_weeks.description: Optional: weeks of temporary benefits already paid (for the 130-week credit).
